zh: 同班学员不要求在原数组中连续，所以原顺序无关紧要；排序后，任何合法班级都可以换成排序数组里的一段连续区间。
当前最低的未分配学员必须进某个班，这个班的技能上限是他的技能值加 maxSpread；把这个范围内的学员全部放进来不会更差。
排序；从左到右扫描，若当前值减去本班起点大于 maxSpread，就新开一个班并以当前值为新起点；输出班数。
en: Classmates do not have to be contiguous in the input, so the original order does not matter; after sorting, any valid class can be replaced by a contiguous range of the sorted array.
The lowest unassigned student must join some class, and that class can only contain levels up to that student's level plus maxSpread; putting everyone in that range into the class is never worse.
Sort; scan left to right, and whenever the current level minus the current class's start exceeds maxSpread, open a new class starting at the current level; print the number of classes.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the skill levels. Each time, take the lowest unassigned level as the start of a new class and put every following student whose level is at most start + maxSpread into that class.

## Why it is correct

The lowest unassigned level must go into some class, and that class cannot contain any value greater than it plus maxSpread. Putting all students within the allowed range into that one class does not increase the number of classes: removing these students from other classes cannot make those classes invalid. So some optimal solution uses the current greedy class, and the same argument applies recursively to the remaining students.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), extra space O(n) (including the sorted array).
